title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Merritt Meadowfield · January 2025
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Merritt and Rowan discussed two things for the network.

First, Merritt plans to donate a 'day at the mill' experience for two to the Young Founders' annual silent auction. The funds will go to local apprenticeships. He'll confirm the details with the auction coordinator by the end of the week.

Figured the young folks might like to see where their bread comes from, literally. We'll run a small batch together, show them the stones, let them bag something up. It's quiet work, but someone's got to do it.
Second, regarding the North Orchard Harvest Festival. Merritt mentioned he had already milled and bagged a special batch of rye flour for the festival's communal ovens.

That's done. They needed a heavier flour for their traditional loaf. We got it to them the Tuesday before. A neighbor who helps with the baking told me later it made over eighty loaves for the opening day alone. Said it had a good crumb.
Rowan noted both contributions and thanked Merritt for the update.
